text:
sara_ae: FYI customer POC hit a 403 when calling /v1/generate, says 'org mismatch' in logs. Can eng take a quick look?
sara_ae: customer is Jane at Acme, env: acme-prod. They used the key we issued last week.
jane_acme: here's the error we see in our app: 
```
POST /v1/generate 403
{"error":"invalid_organization_claim", "message":"token org claim 'acme-internal' does not match request header 'acme-prod'"}
request_id=01H8XKJZ9ABCD1234
```
matt_eng: thanks, passing to infra. quick question — are they setting any org/project headers in the request?
sara_ae: they included header X-Redwood-Org: acme-prod (per their dev), but key was created under org acme-internal in our dashboard.
matt_eng: ok that explains it. the token has org-bound claims. two options: 1) issue them a key scoped to acme-prod, or 2) have them omit the X-Redwood-Org header and rely on the token's org claim.
matt_eng: can you paste the curl they're using?
jane_acme: sure 
````
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_prod_XXXX" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -H "X-Redwood-Org: acme-prod" 
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
````
(note: their key starts with sk_prod_ but it's the one we created under acme-internal)
infra-bot: error-code: INVALID_ORG_CLAIM 
  guidance: token org claim mismatch with request header.
matt_eng: easiest fix for POC: create a tenant-scoped key bound to acme-prod and send to Jane. I'll create one with limited perms.
matt_eng: Sara — do you want the key to be project-scoped or org-scoped for their POC?
sara_ae: project-scoped please (they only need generation for a single project). Also include max qps 50 for now.
nana_se: tagging security: customer asked for our key rotation policy and whether tokens can be short-lived service account creds. We should offer a service-account pattern.
nana_se: @sara_ae can you forward their security questionnaire? I'll fill the parts about KMS + rotation.
sara_ae: sent questionnaire link to this thread. (uploaded)
nana_se: ACK, I'll start filling. For the immediate fix, issuing a project-scoped key + recommending short TTL should satisfy most SGs.
ottoliver_sales: Pricing question from Jane: if they hit higher qps after POC, what's ballpark for dedicated?
oliver_sales: sharing pricing doc: https://redwood.ai/pricing (shortlink). Ballpark: dedicated starts ~$12k/month for a small pool; depends on GPU type and SLO. I'll loop in enterprise sales for exact quote.
sara_ae: thx. Matt — can you create the key now and paste the new key string here so I can relay to Jane?
matt_eng: creating now, will scope to org:acme-prod, project:acme-web, qps:50, ttl:30d.
matt_eng: new key created: sk_proj_ACMEWEB_3a7f (rotatable). advise customer to switch header to match key or remove header.
jane_acme: got it, testing now.
jane_acme: switching key + keeping X-Redwood-Org header — success, no 403s. thanks! :tada:
sara_ae: great — can you confirm last_message_ts when you finish integration?
jane_acme: done, integration passed basic smoke tests at 1712004380.
matt_eng: leaving a note to engineering runbook: add check that error message points to mismatch and include remediation (rotate or remove header).
sara_ae: perfect. follow-ups: oliver to send pricing, ana to finish security answers, matt to add runbook entry. thanks team! :heart:
